title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: I cannot recall where I put my notebook.
sentences.zh: 我想不起把笔记本放哪儿了。

sentences.en: To start with, let's go through what we did today.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们把今天做的事回顾一遍。

sentences.en: Please keep this password in mind.
sentences.zh: 请把这个密码记在心里。

sentences.en: It is easy to mix up the two words.
Divide the long list into small groups.
sentences.zh: 把长清单分成几个小组。

sentences.en: Reviewing often puts your notes to good use.
sentences.zh: 经常复习能让你的笔记派上用场。

sentences.en: Long-term memory lasts much longer than short-term memory.
sentences.zh: 长期记忆比短期记忆持续得久得多。

sentences.en: A squirrel can remember where it hid its nuts.
sentences.zh: 松鼠能记得它把坚果藏在哪里。

sentences.en: In my case, drawing a picture helps me remember.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，画图帮助我记忆。
